Certainly! Here are two hints for the given problem step:

**Hint 1:** Consider the definition of Mean Absolute Error (MAE). It is the average of the absolute differences between the predicted values and the actual values. Think about how different constant predictions might affect these absolute differences.

**Hint 2:** Remember that the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) is minimized when the constant prediction is the median of the observed data. Consider scenarios where there might be multiple medians, especially when the dataset has an even number of observations.
